en: In these chapters— namely *galadṛk*,

*śikṣā*, *iṣettvā*, *aśvastūparaḥ*, *samiddhaḥ*, *añjan*, *sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ*, *tadeva svāhā*, and *prāṇebhyaśca*— no verses (*ṛc*) have been omitted. [However,] in the second chapter, [there is one] regarding *agne*.

In the third chapter, "O Lord of Vows," having entered from behind, there are thirty-three; in the third chapter, "This Agni Purīṣya," having entered, there are sixty-two; in the fifth chapter, "O Agni, Guardian of Vows," having entered, and "O Viṣṇu, go forth," there are forty-one; in the sixth chapter, the first verse has fallen away—"The Revatīs have rejoiced..."—[and so on].

In this [section], there are thirty-five [verses] beginning with "devasya tvā. In the verse beginning with "vācaspataye," there are forty-four due to the omission of "svāṅkṛto'si" and "ātmane me sampṛkte. In the verse beginning with "ādityebhyastvā," there are [verses] beginning with "kadācana" and "saṃ varcasā yuṅkta devā gātuvidaḥ."

In *uduttyam avabhṛthan icumpunaḥ śikvaṃ galite*, there are sixty-seven syllables. In *deva savitar*, there are thirty-nine syllables for *devasya*. In *apo devāḥ*, there are thirty-two syllables for *somasya tviṣir imaṃ devāḥ* [with the final *āḥ* elided]. In *yuñjānaḥ*, there are [the following]: *yuñjate manaḥ*, *viśvo devasya*, and *deva savitaḥ*.

From the common abode of the earth, let the Vasus deliver you; these combined amount to eighty-eight. In the verse beginning with "dṛśāna," there are the two verses "haṃsaḥ śuciṣat" and "akrandadagniḥ"; and "dṛśāno rukmaḥ," "samidhāgniṃ," "punarūrjā," "saharayyā," and "āyante bhavata"—these combined amount to one hundred and eight. [The verses] "mayi gṛhṇāmi," "agnirmūrdhā," and "praviṣṭāḥ" [are included].
The surface of the waters, earth and heaven, the wondrous deeds of Viṣṇu, the fifty-three gods;
the firm-abiding, the bright, and Viśvakarman—these two; the sky and the arrow, you are the king—these together make thirty-six.
O Agni, those born [from thee], Agni, the head, thee, O Agni, from the lotus, thou hast become the sacrifice here, O Agni, this one, O Agni, unto thee.

The *lokampṛṇā* bricks for this [altar] are fifty-two; Indra does not exclude them, making fifty-four. Parameṣṭhin and the two combined make fifty-six. "Homage be to the blue-necked one," "Homage be to the Rudras"—these two combined make sixty-eight.
"O stone, strength," "For thee, of the snow," "Lord of Speech"—[these make seventy-one].

O Viśvakarman, at the rising of the oblation; Indra, all [the nights]; Night and Dawn, O Agni, him; ninety-seven. And strength, of the god; thee, of strength; those which are thine; those which are yours; awaken; wherewith thou carriest; away, thou;
most youthful one, sixty-nine. Sweet art thou; of Vāyu; purified; indeed, O friend.

The *triṇava* [stoma] consists of ninety-three verses: "The womb of sovereignty is in the ocean" (*kṣatrasya yoniḥ samudre*), "Thou art taken with a support" (*upayāmagṛhīto 'si*), "He has sat down like a son" (*putram iva niṣasāda*), "Whether waking" (*yadi jāgrat*), "Whether waters" (*yadāpaḥ*), "Whether by day" (*yad divā*), "Wherein Indra and thou" (*yatrendraś ca yuvam*), and "the Surā-mixture" (*surāmam*)—these constitute ninety.

Then: "This my thread" (*imam me tantum*), "O Vāja, help us in every battle" (*vāje-vāje 'vata*), "The Hotṛ shall sacrifice" (*hotā yakṣat*), "The bull" (*ṛṣabhaḥ*), and "Sarasvatī of the ram" (*sarasvatīm meṣasya*).

Fifty-seven [verses] have been entered: "Thou art splendor," "That [splendor] of Savitṛ," "Of Viśve Devāḥ," "To Pṛthivī Svāhā," "To Madhu Svāhā," "To Vāja Svāhā," "To Asu Svāhā"—nineteen [verses] have been entered. "Hiraṇyagarbhaḥ," "Kuvid aṅga," "Kaḥ svid sūryaḥ," "Ekākī svid dyauḥ," "Āśasīd upayāmagṛhīto 'si"—fifty-seven [verses].

*Śādanda-dadbhiḥ*, *Hiraṇyagarbhaḥ*, *yaḥ prāṇataḥ*—O Agni, these [verses] are forty-four. *Agniś ca vaiśvānaro naḥ* is twenty-five. *Samāstvā* and *ud vayaṃ* are forty-four. *Hotā yakṣad devān daivyā śuciṃ uṣṇihānantaram* and all [the verses] of ours are thirty-five. *Deva...*
*Savitṛ*: twenty-one. *Asyā jarāsaḥ*, *yukṣvā hi*, *ayaṃ mūrdhā divaḥ*, *ud u tyaṃ*, *viśve adya*, *indra vāyū*, *yajño devānām*, *gāva upa daivyā hotārā*, *adabdhebhiḥ*:
eighty-seven. *Yaj jāgrataḥ*, *ā kṛṣṇena*: fifty-seven. *Apo it*, *aśvatthe vaḥ*.

*sumitriyā na āpa oṣadhayaḥ*, *udvayam̐ tamasaspari*, *annāya tvā*, *āyuryajñena kalpatām*, *hyastanam*, *aṣṭādaśa*. *ṛcaṃ vācam*, *bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ*, *kayā naścitra ā bhuvat*, *kaḥ tvā satyo madānām*, *syonā pṛthivi no bhava*, *āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvaḥ*—these three verses, *namaste harase śociṣe*, *sumitriyā na āpa oṣadhayaḥ*, *abhīṣuṇo dṛte*, *dṛṃha*, *trayodaśa*. *devasya tvā savituḥ prasave*, *devī dyāvāpṛthivī*, *indrasyaujaḥ stha*, *aśvasya tvā*.

*Ṛjave tve* (1), *yattryagre praviṣṭāḥ* (1), *trayo hṛde tvā* (1), *yuñjate manaḥ* (1), *praitu makhasya śiraḥ* (1)—these are thirteen. *Devasya tvā* (1), *sumitriyā na āpaḥ* (1), *udvayam* (1), *medho'si* (1), *idam̐ hyagne'dityai rāsnāsi* (1), *indrāya tvā* (1)—these are six; [total] twenty-two. *Īśāvāsyam* (1), *andham tamaḥ* (1), *anyadeva* (1); *sambhūtiṃ ca* (1)—these three combined; *agnenaya* (1).

Thirteen. Thus, when the sixty-four *ṛc*s are omitted, there are one hundred and eleven additional *ṛc*s. When this is done, the number of *kaṇḍikā*s is indeed stated by the noble ones as three hundred and twenty. Thus ends the *Śikṣā* consisting of the enumeration of the omitted *ṛc*s.
